component: LOS (line of sight); negative = away from satellite = subsidence
source: NISAR L2 GUNW (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023) via ASF DAAC, track 114 descending frame 70; https://nisar-docs.asf.alaska.edu/gunw
notes: Cumulative LOS displacement relative to 2025-11-30, sum of 10 consecutive pairs (2025-11-30_2025-12-24, 2025-12-24_2026-01-17, 2026-01-17_2026-01-29, 2026-01-29_2026-02-10, 2026-02-10_2026-02-22, 2026-02-22_2026-03-06, 2026-03-06_2026-03-18, 2026-03-18_2026-04-11, 2026-04-11_2026-04-23, 2026-04-23_2026-05-05). Phase to cm with -lambda/(4*pi), lambda from each file's centerFrequency. Masks: coherence >= 0.3, connectedComponents != 0, isolated patches < 200 px (1.3 km2) removed (unwrapping-error guard), pixels deviating > lambda/4 (half a phase cycle) from their 720 m tile median removed, |pair| > 15.0 cm removed; pixel shown only if valid in every pair. All pairs referenced to the same window at -119.7000E 36.4571N. The ionosphere phase screen shipped in each GUNW was subtracted. A best-fit plane was removed from each pair (long-wavelength atmospheric residual; this can also remove part of any valley-wide tilt). Troposphere and solid-earth-tide layers were NOT applied; residual atmospheric noise of a few cm per pair is expected.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team. This series MIXES provisional products with pre-calibration BETA products (dates before 2026-06-17); treat amplitudes before that date with extra caution.
